newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui Petrochem, Mitsui Toatsu to announce merger.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Petrochem, Mitsui Toatsu to announce merger.

text.p: Mitsui Petrochemical Industries Ltd and Mitsui Toatsu Chemicals Inc said on Monday they will officially announce a merger between them at 4.30 p.m. (0730 GMT) in Tokyo.
The two companies said in early September that they were considering merging as early as October 1997.
The merger will create the second-largest petrochemical company in Japan, earlier reports said.
The reports said Mitsui Toatsu Chemicals will be dissolved on the merger. They said 0.5 to 0.6 of a Mitsui Petrochemical share would be exchanged for each Mitsui Toatsu share.
Analysts earlier said such a merger would be aimed at boosting the companies' international competitiveness.
